Alibaba prices? Yes. Wondering if my shades are currently lost somewhere in the Pacific Ocean? Maybe not yet. If international shipping/customs is the part making you nervous about ordering from Alibaba, try filtering your search by U.S. Stock first. There are WAY more products already sitting in U.S. warehouses than I expected! cabinets, furniture, vanities, building materials and more. Just remember: U.S. Stock doesn’t mean you stop asking questions. Confirm your exact item + quantity are actually in the U.S., where they’re shipping from, domestic freight cost and delivery time before paying. Ever wonder where the products taking over your feed actually come from? 👀 I went to Alibaba.com CoCreate, and it felt like walking through my TikTok Shop feed in real life—except you could meet the suppliers and manufacturers who help bring those products to life. For product founders, it’s an opportunity to get out of the endless online search and actually see samples, compare materials, explore packaging, and ask questions face-to-face. How much would this cost to make? What’s the minimum order? Could we customize it? Whether you’re starting a beauty brand, developing a new invention, or expanding an existing product line, those conversations can shape what you build. You might show up looking for a manufacturer and discover a product format you didn’t even know was possible. That’s what makes a sourcing event like Alibaba CoCreate so valuable: you get a much clearer picture of how to turn an idea into a physical product—and who could help you do it.
